metadata.description: Forty-item caregiver questionnaire for autism-related social communication and behavior history.
metadata.intended_use: Screening and referral support for children and adolescents with possible autism-related characteristics.
metadata.development_history: Derived from the Autism Diagnostic Interview framework as a briefer caregiver screening tool.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Caregiver-reported developmental social communication and restricted behavior indicators support referral decisions.
metadata.interpretation_notes: A screening result requires developmental evaluation; age, language, intellectual ability, and informant knowledge affect interpretation.

versions.source_citation: Rutter, Bailey, and Lord. Social Communication Questionnaire; German reference edition.
